parameters.name: filter[status]
parameters.description: Filter by status enum value (e.g. processing, picked, packed, fulfilled, cancelled, other)

parameters.name: filter[has_fulfillment]
parameters.description: Filter by fulfillment link: true/1 = has SKU fulfillment, false/0 = no fulfillment

parameters.name: filter[date_from]
parameters.description: Filter by order date from (any parseable date, e.g. 2024-01-01)

parameters.name: filter[date_to]
parameters.description: Filter by order date to (any parseable date)

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field (prefix with - for DESC). Allowed: id, order_number, status, created_at, updated_at
